name: aker-website
description: AKER OSGB kurumsal web sitesi - statik site, Cloudflare Pages

scripts.build: npm run bundle && npm run pages
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && tsc -p tsconfig.functions.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.db:setup: wrangler d1 execute aker-website --local --file=db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute aker-website --local --file=db/seed.sql
scripts.db:setup:remote: wrangler d1 execute aker-website --remote --file=db/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute aker-website --remote --file=db/seed.sql
